dialogs.onboarding.title: Set up your product experience workspace
dialogs.onboarding.description: No projects are available yet. You can mount an existing project folder, install the sanitized example, or continue with an empty platform.
dialogs.onboarding.invalidProjectsHint: Open the project package manager or the health check center to see the exact errors and fix suggestions.
dialogs.onboarding.exampleFailed: Failed to create the example project
dialogs.onboarding.skip: Skip for now and enter the empty platform
dialogs.onboarding.skipHint: “Skip for now” is only recorded in the current browser and is never written into the project directory.
dialogs.share.hintManaged: The service started with a LAN address; sharing is controlled by the startup options.
dialogs.share.hintReadOnly: The service is running in read-only mode; sharing cannot be toggled.
dialogs.share.hintNoControl: Only the service host (or an authorized browser after enabling remote management) can toggle sharing.
dialogs.share.hintDefault: When enabled, devices on the same network can view projects, prototypes, and PRDs in read-only mode.
dialogs.share.unavailableDescription: The platform is currently served by the dev server or a static deployment, which does not provide the share control API. Start the standalone service with npm run serve:local to enable it.
dialogs.share.title: LAN read-only sharing
dialogs.share.noLanUrls: Sharing is enabled, but no usable LAN address was detected.
dialogs.projectConfig.errorMinClients: A project must keep at least one client.
dialogs.projectConfig.errorInvalidColor: The theme color must be a six-digit hex value, for example #2563eb.
dialogs.projectConfig.errorClientNames: Please fill in every client name.
dialogs.projectConfig.errorDuplicateId: This project ID already exists. Adjust the project name and save again.
dialogs.projectConfig.intro: Only the content entry points are configured here; the platform handles the other engineering details automatically.
dialogs.projectConfig.projectSectionHint: Set the project name, document source, and unified theme color.
dialogs.projectConfig.autoGeneratedHint: The project ID, slug, and version are generated automatically.
dialogs.projectConfig.docsRootPlaceholde: A directory inside the project or an absolute local path; leave empty if none
dialogs.projectConfig.docsRootHint: Filling this in enables the Docs Center; leaving it empty hides the docs entry.
dialogs.projectConfig.primaryColorHint: Applied to client shells, primary buttons, links, and selected states.

dialogs.projectConfig.homepageVisibleHin: When off, the project does not appear in the project list on the home page.
dialogs.projectConfig.clientsSectionHint: Each client only needs a name, a page structure, and a content source.
dialogs.projectConfig.prototypeRootPlace: Leave empty to use engineering pages
dialogs.projectConfig.customPresetDescri: This project uses an existing custom entry page; it is kept as-is when saving.
dialogs.mount.title: Mount an existing project folder
dialogs.mount.noCopyTitle: Project files are never copied or moved
dialogs.mount.noCopyDescription: The platform only records the folder in the local project-mounts.local.json. Unmounting never deletes the source files.
dialogs.mount.folderPlaceholder: Select or enter an absolute path containing project.json
dialogs.mount.candidateDescription: Passed project config, page definition, and asset checks. {{count}} client(s).
